how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named suite run against it, then the file restored before the next row (X14/X15's convention). X38 adds no test, so these are the three cases it had to rewrite to keep their teeth once the between-task reset was gone: each row breaks the behaviour the rewritten assertion still guards. scripts/__tests__/lease-pool-cli.test.js runs entirely against fake `adb`/`simctl` stubs in a temporary NITRO_UI_HOME, so no lease was taken and no device was touched. Run on maintainer-mac-1, 2026-11-15, against HEAD f0eecd2a.

mutations.mutation: put hand-off device traffic back: the warm-reuse probe addresses the serial with `pm clear` as well as the readiness check
redTests: boots the pair it hands out when told to, from the shared launch config

touches only the emulator for an Android-only lease
